description: This is a Swift source file defining a catalog and presentation logic for device models, including mapping device identifiers to human-readable names and icons, as well as handling resource bundle loading.

classes.name: DevicePresentation
classes.description: A simple data structure representing the display information of a device, including a title and optional symbol.

methods.name: presentation
methods.description: Returns a DevicePresentation object with a friendly title and symbol based on device family and model identifiers.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Determines a symbol string for a device based on family and model identifiers.

methods.name: symbolFor
methods.description: Private method that maps a model identifier to a system symbol, with fallback logic.

methods.name: fallbackSymbol
methods.description: Provides a default symbol based on device family when specific mapping is unavailable.

methods.name: loadModelIdentifierToName
methods.description: Loads and combines device identifier-to-name mappings from JSON resources.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads a JSON mapping resource and decodes it into a dictionary.

methods.name: locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Locates the resource bundle containing device model JSON files.

methods.name: bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks whether a given bundle contains device model JSON resources.

methods.name: NameValue.init
methods.description: Decodable enum initializer that handles string or array of strings representations.

methods.name: NameValue.normalizedName
methods.description: Returns a cleaned-up, combined string representation of the name(s).
